an7.20:1.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sikkhāsamādāne tibbacchando hoti āyatiṃ ca sikkhāsamādāne adhigatapemo
an7.20:1.4: dhammanisantiyā tibbacchando hoti āyatiṃ ca dhammanisantiyā adhigatapemo
an7.20:1.5: icchāvinaye tibbacchando hoti āyatiṃ ca icchāvinaye adhigatapemo
an7.20:1.6: paṭisallāne tibbacchando hoti āyatiṃ ca paṭisallāne adhigatapemo
an7.20:1.7: viriyārambhe tibbacchando hoti āyatiṃ ca viriyārambhe adhigatapemo
an7.20:1.8: satinepakke tibbacchando hoti āyatiṃ ca satinepakke adhigatapemo
an7.20:1.9: diṭṭhipaṭivedhe tibbacchando hoti āyatiṃ ca diṭṭhipaṭivedhe adhigatapemo.
